    def test_check_dcat_catalog(self):
        mock_stdout = io.StringIO()
        sys.stdout = mock_stdout
        self.dcc.check_dcat_catalog("http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl")
        sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__

        output = mock_stdout.getvalue()
        json_objects = [json.loads(line) for line in output.splitlines()]

        for result in json_objects:
            # good distributions have one successful check
            if "/good" in result.get("id"):
                self.assertEqual(result.get("num_good_checks"), 1)

            # bad distributions do not a successful check
            if "/bad" in result.get("id"):
                self.assertEqual(result.get("num_good_checks"), 0)
